label: halloweenmakoto1
title_zh: 从周日算起的六种方式

lines.en: label halloweenmakoto1:
scene makotodecorates1
: {i}Are you sure you’re ready to start insulting her like everything is normal again?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你确定你已经准备好像什么都没发生过一样照常损她了吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Some things never change even when everything else in the world does, Ayane.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就算世上一切都变了，有些事也永远不会变，Ayane。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}This is but one of them.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这只是其中之一。{/i}

lines.en: : Do you ever get the feeling that someone’s talking about you behind your back?
lines.zh: : 你有没有过那种感觉，觉得有人在你背后议论你？

lines.en: : Yeah. Figure with the way I am though, it normally just means somebody {i}is.{/i}
lines.zh: : 有啊。不过以我这德行，那通常只是意味着真的{i}有人{/i}在议论。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates2
: You’re not {i}that{/i} bad, Yumi. Like, yes, you’re an asshole. But you can be nice on occasion. Like how you showed up to help decorate even though you haven’t come to school in weeks.
lines.zh: : 你也没{i}那么{/i}差啦，Yumi。好吧，你确实是个混蛋。但你偶尔也可以是好人的。比如你明明已经好几个星期没来学校了，还是跑来帮忙布置。

lines.en: : Ain’t like I got anythin’ else goin’ on. Chika dumped me and I ain’t got a fuckin’ clue where my mom is.
lines.zh: : 反正我也没别的事可做。Chika 把我甩了，我妈在哪儿我也他妈一无所知。

lines.en: : But you so much as think about handin’ over any work I may have missed and I’m adding one more nerd to the list of girls whose teeth I’ve knocked in.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是敢想着把我落下的作业交给我，我就在被我打掉牙的女生名单上再加一个书呆子。

lines.en: : Makoto! Where the frick are we supposed to put these ghost things? I still ain’t got any idea what we’re doin’ here!
lines.zh: : Makoto！这些鬼东西到底该放哪儿啊？我到现在都不知道我们在这儿干嘛！

lines.en: : We can probably just throw them next to the door and sort of ease people into the scares, you know? No one is going to be afraid of these little guys.
lines.zh: : 我们大概就扔在门边就行，算是让人慢慢进入受惊的状态吧，你懂的？没人会怕这些小家伙的。

lines.en: : Just put them wherever, you two. Ayane said she doesn’t care how we handle the decorating. But people are going to start showing up any minute now and I don’t want-
lines.zh: : 你们俩随便放哪儿都行。Ayane 说了她不在乎我们怎么布置。不过大家随时都可能到了，我可不想——

lines.en: scene makotodecorates3
: {i}Blah, blah, blah. I’m Makoto. I like to pretend I’m an interior designer when all I really know how to do is sell dildos. Blah blah blah.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}巴拉巴拉巴拉。我是 Makoto。我喜欢假装自己是个室内设计师，可我真正会的只有卖假阳具。巴拉巴拉巴拉。{/i}

lines.en: : Well, at least they’re working.
lines.zh: : 好吧，至少她们在干活。

lines.en: : Surprised Noriko’s still standin’, to be honest. Bitch pulled an all-nighter at the convenience store last night. Don’t think she’s slept for even a minute.
lines.zh: : 说实话，Noriko 还能站着我都觉得惊讶。这丫头昨晚在便利店通了个宵。我看她一分钟都没睡。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates4
: Oh, right. You two work together now, don’t you? I thought it was weird when you showed up at the same time.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。你们俩现在在一起打工，是吧？我就说你们同时出现有点奇怪。

lines.en: : She works. I kinda just stand there and clean tables every now and then. Barely any customers in the old district. But hey, money is money and I ain’t about to turn it down.
lines.zh: : 她是真上班。我基本就是站着，偶尔擦擦桌子。老城区几乎没客人。不过嘿，钱就是钱，我可不会往外推。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates5
: Maybe that’s where this new semi-reliable side of you comes from then?
lines.zh: : 那你这副还算靠谱的新样子，大概就是从这儿来的？

lines.en: : Or maybe I’m just fuckin’ fed up with bein’ hated by everybody. Shit’s tiring. Just want that fuckin’ reset thing to happen already so some shred of normalcy comes back into my life.
lines.zh: : 或者只是我他妈受够了被所有人讨厌。这破事太累人了。我只想那该死的重置赶紧发生，好让我的生活恢复一点点正常。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates6
: The only way that happens is if you forget about the resets entirely. Knowing they’re real sort of...changes your perspective of things in a lot of ways.
lines.zh: : 要做到这一点，唯一的办法就是你彻底把重置这件事忘掉。知道它们是真的，在某种程度上……会从很多方面改变你看待事物的方式。

lines.en: : Well, sign me the fuck up for that because I ain’t got the energy to deal with the end of the god damn world on top of all of everything else goin’ on.
lines.zh: : 行啊，那他妈赶紧给我报上名，因为我可没力气在其他一堆破事之外再去应付什么该死的世界末日。

lines.en: : Well, what’s “everything else” exactly? As someone else that everyone in the class dislikes, maybe I can help?
lines.zh: : 嗯，那「其他一堆破事」具体是什么？作为全班都不喜欢的另一个人，也许我能帮上忙？

lines.en: scene makotodecorates7
: Nah, fuck off. I ain’t about to drag you into my shit too. Thanks for tryin’, though.
lines.zh: : 不，滚蛋。我可不想把你也拖进我这摊烂事里。不过还是谢了。

lines.en: : I’m not trying to, like...give you a counseling session, Yumi. I just figured it might be good for you to get something off your chest to someone else who doesn’t give a shit anymore.
lines.zh: : 我又不是要……给你做心理咨询什么的，Yumi。我只是觉得，跟一个同样已经不在乎的人吐吐槽，对你可能有好处。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates8
: You? Ain’t your whole ass thing givin’ {i}so many{/i} shits that you become un-fucking-bearable?
lines.zh: : 你？你的看家本领不就是{i}在乎得要死{/i}，在乎到让人他妈受不了吗？

lines.en: : You’re thinking of old Makoto. New Makoto just wants to relax and get laid.
lines.zh: : 你说的是旧版的 Makoto。新版 Makoto 只想放松，顺便上床。

lines.en: : Oh is {i}that{/i} what the bondage gear is for? Kinda figured it was a costume because it’s Halloween and shit. But hey, you do you.
lines.zh: : 哦，{i}那{/i}就是你穿这身捆绑装的原因？我还以为是因为万圣节才穿的戏服什么的。不过嘿，你开心就好。

lines.en: : I will. That’s sort of my whole policy now that I know nothing has consequences anymore.
lines.zh: : 我会的。既然我知道了什么都不会有后果，这差不多就是我的全部人生信条了。

lines.en: : Well if that’s true, why the hell are you spendin’ your free time setting up some Halloween party?
lines.zh: : 那如果真是这样，你他妈干嘛还把空闲时间花在布置什么万圣节派对上？

lines.en: : Our infinite timeline may have shaped me into someone who cares less about her future, but I am still a control freak at the end of the day. And if I didn’t volunteer to do this, no one would have.
lines.zh: : 我们这条无限的时间线也许把我塑造成了不太在乎未来的人，但说到底我还是个控制狂。而且如果我不主动揽下这事，没人会干。

lines.en: : Don’t see how that matters but, again, you do you.
lines.zh: : 我不明白这有什么要紧的，不过再说一遍，你开心就好。

lines.en: : What will {i}you{/i} do, though? Now that you know about stuff, I mean.
lines.zh: : 不过{i}你{/i}打算怎么办？我是说，既然你现在知道这些事了。

lines.en: : More of the same, I guess? Lay low until the world blows up? I don’t know — what am I supposed to do?
lines.zh: : 大概还是老样子吧？低调做人，等世界炸掉？我不知道——我到底该怎么办？

lines.en: : That depends on what you want, I guess. Given what’s happened in the past, it’s highly probable that your mind won’t even {i}survive{/i} the reset again.
lines.zh: : 我想这取决于你想要什么。考虑到过去发生的事，很有可能你的意识根本{i}撑不过{/i}下一次重置。

lines.en: : Okay. The fuck’s that supposed to mean, though?
lines.zh: : 行。不过这他妈到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : That you can basically do anything you want and then not have to worry about regretting it since you’ll forget once things start over. Probably.
lines.zh: : 意思是你基本可以想干什么就干什么，完全不用担心后悔，因为一切重来的时候你就会忘掉。大概吧。

lines.en: : Probably?
lines.zh: : 大概？

lines.en: : I don’t really get how it works either. I just know some information stays and some goes. But you can ask me again for a clearer answer several loops from now if we’re both still ourselves.
lines.zh: : 我也没搞懂这到底是怎么回事。我只知道有些信息会留下，有些会消失。不过如果几轮循环之后我们俩都还是我们自己，你可以再来问我，到时我给你个更清楚的答案。

lines.en: : And if we ain’t?
lines.zh: : 那要是我们不是了呢？

lines.en: : Then we’ll probably just keep reliving freshman year of high school over and over until someone figures out how to break us out. If we even {i}can{/i} break out. But honestly, what’s even the point?
lines.zh: : 那我们大概只能一遍又一遍地重读高一，直到有人想出怎么把我们弄出去。如果我们{i}真能{/i}出去的话。不过说实话，那又有什么意义？

lines.en: scene makotodecorates9
: Not bein’ a teenager anymore. This shit sucks.
lines.zh: : 意义就是不再是青少年啊。这破事糟透了。

lines.en: : Maybe for you. But life doesn’t get any easier as you get older. Responsibilities multiply, expectations multiply, {i}pressure{/i} multiplies — and you just have to lie there and take it because you’re an “adult.”
lines.zh: : 也许是吧，对你来说。可人越长大，日子并不会越好过。责任成倍增加，期望成倍增加，{i}压力{/i}也成倍增加——而你就只能躺在那儿受着，因为你是「成年人」了。

lines.en: : At least when we’re young, we can fall back on that fact. We don’t {i}have{/i} to be perfect because no one expects us to be. It’s the best time to do stupid stuff and make stupid mistakes.
lines.zh: : 至少我们年轻的时候，还能拿这一点当退路。我们{i}不必{/i}完美，因为没人对我们有这种期待。这是干蠢事、犯蠢错的最佳时机。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates10

: But the thing with me is I’ve always been so focused on the future that I didn’t leave any room to {i}make{/i} those mistakes. Which effectively robbed me of what are supposed to be the best years of my life.
lines.zh: : 但我的问题在于，我一直太盯着未来，根本没给自己留出{i}犯{/i}那些错的余地。这实际上剥夺了我本该是人生中最美好的那些年。

lines.en: : So...just to make sure I’m understandin’ shit, you’re sayin’ that now that you ain’t gotta worry about growin’ up, you can just...chill? Am I gettin’ that right?
lines.zh: : 所以……我确认一下我有没有听懂，你是说既然你不用担心长大了，就可以……躺平了？我理解得对吗？

lines.en: : Pretty much, yeah. And I think you can benefit from doing the same thing, Yumi. Which isn’t to say I think you’ve put {i}any{/i} amount of thought into your future to begin with. But now, you don’t have to.
lines.zh: : 差不多，没错。而且我觉得你这么做也会有好处，Yumi。我并不是说你{i}曾经{/i}为自己的未来花过哪怕一丁点心思。但现在，你不用操心了。

lines.en: : That’s why I will {i}not{/i} be giving you any of the work you’ve missed out on during your prolonged absence since it literally does not matter. But old Makoto {i}would{/i} have because she sucked.
lines.zh: : 所以我{i}不会{/i}把你长期缺课落下的作业交给你，因为那根本无关紧要。不过旧版的 Makoto {i}会{/i}这么做，因为她很讨厌。

lines.en: : Well, damn. Maybe this shit ain’t that bad then. And maybe new Makoto ain’t that bad either.
lines.zh: : 哎，好吧。那这事儿也许没那么糟。也许新版 Makoto 也没那么讨厌。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates11
: That just depends on your definition of “bad.” Because having a lack of consequences makes me more brazen as well. And I would now gladly throw anyone under the bus so long as it will benefit me.
lines.zh: : 那要看你怎么定义「讨厌」了。因为没有了后果，我也变得更肆无忌惮。现在我愿意把任何人推到车轮底下，只要对我有利。

lines.en: : That ain’t bad either. That’s how shit {i}should{/i} be. Ain’t nobody else gonna matter in the long run, so livin’ for yourself is all you can really do.
lines.zh: : 那也不算坏。事情{i}本来就该{/i}是这样。到头来没人在乎别人，所以为自己而活是你唯一能做的事。

lines.en: : No, you’re not getting it. Nobody else matters because there {i}is{/i} no long run. There is here and now. But we’ll be right back here {i}again.{/i} That’s why I stopped caring.
lines.zh: : 不，你没懂。没人在乎别人，是因为{i}根本{/i}就没有什么「到头来」。只有此时此刻。但我们马上又会{i}再次{/i}回到这里。这就是我不再在乎的原因。

lines.en: scene black
{b}MAKOTO FINALLY FINISHES POSITIONING THE PUMPKIN THING AND STANDS UP WOW THAT TOOK A LONG TIME{/b}
lines.zh: {b}MAKOTO 终于把那个南瓜玩意儿摆好、站起身来 哇哦 这可真够久的{/b}

lines.en: scene makotodecorates12
: Take Sensei for example. Under normal circumstances, I’d try to keep the fact that I have screwed him six ways from Sunday a secret from you.
lines.zh: : 拿 Sensei 举个例子。正常情况下，我会想方设法瞒着你，不让你知道我把他翻来覆去睡了个遍。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates13
: Ew, what the fuck?!
lines.zh: : 呕，什么鬼？！

lines.en: : But {i}now,{/i} I don’t {i}care{/i} if you know because it isn’t going to negatively affect anything! Everyone can find out about me and the only impact will be {i}short{/i} term effects, not long term ones.
lines.zh: : 但{i}现在{/i}，我{i}不在乎{/i}你知不知道，因为这事不会造成任何负面影响！谁都可以知道我的事，唯一的影响也就是{i}短{/i}期的，而不是长期的。

lines.en: : So yes, you might hit me a few times. But that would be a brand new experience I’d have never had if it weren’t for the confidence this world has given me! I can do so much experimenting now!
lines.zh: : 所以没错，你可能会打我几下。但那会是一种全新的体验——要不是这个世界给了我自信，我永远不会有这种体验！我现在可以做超多尝试！

lines.en: scene makotodecorates14
: So...you really {i}have{/i} been hookin’ up with that guy then?
lines.zh: : 所以……你{i}真的{/i}一直在跟那家伙乱搞？

lines.en: : {i}Oh yeah.{/i} Since even {i}before{/i} I knew about the loops. So suffice it to say, I don’t care much about “safe” sex anymore.
lines.zh: : {i}哦，是啊。{/i}早在我知道循环的事{i}之前{/i}就开始了。所以说，我已经不太在乎「安全」性行为了。

lines.en: : And you ain’t even a little embarrassed to just outright admit that?
lines.zh: : 你就这么直白地承认，一点都不害臊？

lines.en: : Nope. Having all the time in the world to be embarrassed has, weirdly enough, made it hard to feel embarrassed about anything at all. I love this.
lines.zh: : 不害臊。说来也怪，有了一辈子的时间可以拿来害臊，反倒让我很难再对任何事情感到害臊了。我太喜欢这样了。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates15
: I’m not sure what reaction I was expecting from you, but this definitely isn’t it.
lines.zh: : 我不确定我期待你有什么反应，但肯定不是这个。

lines.en: : The old you really wasn’t that bad, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 旧版的你其实没那么讨厌，Makoto。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates16
: I know we ain’t ever been friends and shit, but I’ve always thought it was impressive how you could, like...be all responsible and whatnot. And I know you helped cover up my absences, so...
lines.zh: : 我知道我们从来就不是朋友什么的，但我一直觉得挺了不起的，你能……那么有责任感什么的。而且我知道你帮我瞒过缺课的事，所以……

lines.en: : I just think it’s kinda shitty that it took some crazy supernatural shit to make you feel less...pressure or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得有点糟心，非得发生这种超自然的破事，才能让你少点……压力什么的。

lines.en: : And I obviously ain’t gonna tell you how you should be livin’ your life- especially if you’re finally enjoyin’ yourself now. I just...
lines.zh: : 而且我显然不会去教你该怎么过日子——尤其是你现在终于过得开心了。我只是……

lines.en: : It doesn’t...feel good...playin’ with other people’s feelings to try and boost your own self-esteem. And even if there ain’t gonna be any long-term consequences if you do that {i}now...{/i}it still sucks.
lines.zh: : 为了抬高自己的自尊心去玩弄别人的感情……感觉并不好受。而且就算你{i}现在{/i}这么做不会有什么长期后果……那也很糟糕。

lines.en: : And if you’re just gonna do that shit to “experiment” or whatever...I really will kick your ass.
lines.zh: : 如果你只是想拿这种事来「做实验」什么的……我真的会揍你。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates17
: Wow.
: Wow what?
lines.zh: : 哇什么？

lines.en: : I’m just thinking of how powerful time loops really are if they can turn me into the bad guy and you into the adorable good one.
lines.zh: : 我只是在想，时间循环到底有多强大——居然能把我变成反派，把你变成可爱的好人。

lines.en: : That was so cute that I’d hug you if it wouldn’t immediately result in my neck being snapped.
lines.zh: : 那番话太可爱了，要不是怕脖子当场被拧断，我真想抱你一下。

lines.en: : I’m only sayin’ that shit in the first place since I know I ain’t gonna remember it if I do get sent back again. That was embarrassing as fuck.
lines.zh: : 我之所以会说那些话，只是因为我知道万一又被送回去，我根本不会记得。真是尴尬死了。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates18
: For now. But like I said, you’ll quickly come to learn that the longer this drags on, the {i}harder{/i} it is to feel that way.
lines.zh: : 目前是这样。不过就像我说的，你很快就会明白，这种日子拖得越久，就越{i}难{/i}再有那种感觉。

lines.en: : Every day, things feel less real. I start each morning the same way...and I end each night the same way.
lines.zh: : 每一天，一切都感觉越来越不真实。我每个早晨都以同样的方式开始……每个夜晚也都以同样的方式结束。

lines.en: : And while that’s no different from my morning and night rituals when I {i}wasn’t{/i} a perpetual high-schooler, it’s so much easier to do now that I know it won’t suddenly be ten years later one day.
lines.zh: : 虽然这跟我{i}还不是{/i}永远的高中生时的早晚例行没什么两样，但现在做起来容易多了，因为我知道不会某天一觉醒来突然就过了十年。

lines.en: : Because that’s always been the fear — holding my breath for so long that my life has just passed by without even realizing it. And {i}that’s{/i} not scary anymore either. I’m not going {i}anywhere.{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为那一直是我害怕的事——屏住呼吸憋得太久，结果人生就这么不知不觉地溜走了。而现在{i}那件事{/i}也不可怕了。我哪儿也{i}去不了{/i}。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates19
: But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : All that stuff about me throwing people under the bus to make myself feel better? That isn’t going to {i}actually{/i} happen. It’s all talk. I’m trying to convince {i}myself{/i} that that’s who I am.
lines.zh: : 我说会把别人推到车轮底下来让自己好受？那{i}其实{/i}不会发生的。只是嘴上说说。我是在试图说服{i}我自己{/i}，我就是那种人。

lines.en: : But when you peel off this bondage suit, I’m still the same control-freak I’ve always been. I still can’t help but care, even {i}if{/i} it’s for people I don’t necessarily care {i}about.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可把这身捆绑装脱下来，我还是那个一直以来的控制狂。我还是忍不住会在乎，{i}就算{/i}在乎的是那些我未必{i}在乎{/i}的人。

lines.en: : The only difference is I’m a little more honest now. But that’s more about being honest with myself than it is about being honest with people like you.
lines.zh: : 唯一的区别是我现在更诚实了一点。不过那更多是对我自己诚实，而不是对你们这种人诚实。

lines.en: : Once more — the fuck is any of that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 再说一遍——这他妈到底是什么意思？

lines.en: scene makotodecorates20

: Don’t worry about it, Yumi. I won’t bore you with any more unwanted apocalyptic advice. The best course of action will always be figuring out what {i}you{/i} want to do with that time. Not someone else.
lines.zh: : 别在意了，Yumi。我不会再拿你不爱听的末日说教烦你。最好的做法永远是想清楚{i}你{/i}自己想拿那些时间做什么。而不是别人。

lines.en: : I am now harnessing the power of new Makoto to give you my blessing.
lines.zh: : 现在我要动用新版 Makoto 的力量，赐给你我的祝福。

lines.en: : What blessing? The fuck are you talkin’ about?
lines.zh: : 什么祝福？你他妈在说什么？

lines.en: scene makotodecorates21
: To do whatever you want. Or...{i}whoever{/i} you want.
lines.zh: : 去做你想做的任何事。或者……{i}任何人{/i}。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates22

: Y...You fuckin’...I ain’t a fuckin’ moron, Makoto! I know what you’re insinuatin’ there! And it’s the same damn thing that’s made shit so fucking...shitty for me lately! There ain’t {i}anybody{/i} I want to do!
lines.zh: : 你……你他妈的……我又不是傻子，Makoto！我知道你在暗示什么！而这正是最近把我生活搞得这么他妈……糟心的同一件事！我{i}根本{/i}没有想做的人！

lines.en: : Okaaaaay. But it’s the best possible time to try it out since there’s a chance you won’t even remember it in the future! Your brain could turn back into soup any day now!
lines.zh: : 好——吧。不过现在是尝试的最佳时机，因为你说不定将来根本就不记得了！你的脑子随时可能变回一锅汤！

lines.en: : My brain ain’t soup! And I ain’t about to spend the beginning of a potentially infinite life spreading my legs for some dude who should’ve been behind bars {i}years{/i} ago if what you say is true!
lines.zh: : 我的脑子不是汤！而且我可不想把一段可能无限漫长的人生的开头，用来给某个按你说的{i}早该在好多年前{/i}就进监狱的家伙张开腿！

lines.en: scene makotodecorates23

: What {i}will{/i} you do then, Yumi? Will it really be “more of the same” like you said? Or will you actually try to venture outside of the box now that you know there isn’t anything dangerous out there?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}要怎么办，Yumi？真会像你说的「还是老样子」吗？还是说，既然知道外面并没有什么危险，你真的会试着跳出那个框框？

lines.en: : More of the same. Exactly like I said. This shit’s just a vacation as far as I’m concerned. So you can go ahead and keep being a fucking loser and I’ll keep being a fucking asshole. End of story.
lines.zh: : 还是老样子。就是我说的那样。在我看来这破事就是个假期。所以你尽管继续当你那该死的失败者，我继续当我这该死的混蛋。到此为止。

lines.en: : Middle of story. There’s no ending in sight here.
lines.zh: : 是故事中间。这里根本看不到结局。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates24
: That might be true for now, but-
lines.zh: : 目前也许是这样，不过——

lines.en: scene makotodecorates25
scene makotodecorates26
: Fuck off, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 滚蛋，Makoto。

lines.en: : I see that the...strange...egg...things from the last Halloween party have...made a comeback.
lines.zh: : 我看到了，上次万圣节派对上那些……奇怪的……蛋……东西又……回来了。

lines.en: : Target identified — large skull. Possibly real. Primed for collecting. Goal — find a ladder. Bonus objective — don’t let Ayane find out.
lines.zh: : 目标确认——巨大的骷髅头。可能是真的。已做好收集准备。目标——找一架梯子。附加目标——别让 Ayane 发现。

lines.en: : There’s a ladder over here, Rin. Just be careful. Miku already knocked one of the skeletons over earlier.
lines.zh: : 梯子在这儿，Rin。小心点。Miku 早些时候已经撞倒了一具骷髅。

lines.en: scene makotodecorates27
: Chika! Futaba! Help me move the ladder and we can all take turns with the skull!
lines.zh: : Chika！Futaba！帮我搬梯子，我们就能轮流玩那个骷髅头了！

lines.en: : Take turns...doing {i}what{/i} exactly?
lines.zh: : 轮流……{i}干{/i}什么？

lines.en: : Exactly!
lines.zh: : 没错！

lines.en: : ...What?
: Can you two handle it on your own, Rin? There’s...something I’ve gotta do first.
lines.zh: : 你们俩能自己搞定吗，Rin？我有……点事得先去办。

lines.en: scene black
: Hm? I mean...we can {i}try.{/i} But you’re the strong one here. Futaba and I only equal like one third of a Chika in power. And even less in sex appeal.
lines.zh: : 嗯？我的意思是……我们可以{i}试试{/i}。但你是这儿力气最大的那个。我和 Futaba 加起来的力量大概只有三分之一个 Chika。性魅力就更少了。

lines.en: : Sex appeal doesn’t move ladders, Rin.
lines.zh: : 性魅力可搬不动梯子，Rin。

lines.en: : Not with that attitude, it doesn’t! Come on, Futaba! Let’s seduce a ladder!
lines.zh: : 抱着这种态度当然搬不动！来吧，Futaba！我们去勾引一架梯子！
